kind: Read-only extraction of the caller's installed original Japanese Switch game assets
scope: Only the 13 disputed choice strings and their SELR references; not a full script dump or a gameplay run

asset_identity.detection: Unprefixed allpac/allui archives; no w_allpac.nam, following Knife's assets::detect_build

provenance_limit: These are the caller's local extracted original Japanese assets, not a Switch hardware capture or an independently preserved eShop receipt/control.nacp. Distribution packaging and installed Switch patch version are not independently identified by this bundle. No 2024 equivalence is claimed. Independent accuracy review must assess applicability; this artifact is not approval.
save_safety: The game was not launched. The decoder and verifier only read script_text.mrg and allscr.mrg. No save was loaded, copied, unlocked, written or restored; the original save's size, modification time and SHA-256 were checked unchanged privately.

choices.text: パンを買って教室で済ませよう。
……迷うのはここまでだ。残ろう。
もうすこしアルクェイドと話をする。
『………（いや、下手な言葉は逆効果だ）』
『それ以上進んだら嫌いになるからなっ！』
……大聖堂ってなに？　と訊いてみる。
黒鍵ってなに？　と訊いてみる。

unicode_notes.questions: The space following ？ in text IDs 42734 and 42735 is U+3000 IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE, not U+0020 or an omitted space.
unicode_notes.bars: Text IDs 42694 and 42695 begin with three U+2015 HORIZONTAL BAR characters.
unicode_notes.hesitation: Text ID 42755 begins with six U+2026 HORIZONTAL ELLIPSIS characters.
unicode_notes.glasses: Text ID 42751 uses は, not を.
unicode_notes.numbering: Knife's SELR renderer separately adds the numbered option prefix; it is not part of these original choice payload strings.
